title: A way out when a card's model runs out of usage
text: When the model behind a card runs out of usage, the card now says so and names the model. From the card you can try again once usage is added, hand the work to a different model with "Select new agent", or, for a code review, skip the review and approve without it. Handing the work to another model of the same tool keeps the agent's session, so nothing is lost. Choosing a different model for a code review applies to that card only, so a review that ran out no longer leaves the card stuck.

more.title: Usage limits show the model and keep it on retry
more.text: Cards identify the worker or reviewer that hit a usage limit, even before its session opens. Try again keeps the code review on the same model, including when the reviewer was selected just for that run.
